requirement: Review fixes of #1026: notes dated by the plugin's clock, Chinese quotes kept, no note rewritten without the customer's words, a separator in a note's text, the build tool of an open build, dryRun only for content.replace, read keeps dsh's line cap, EmDash picture undo by the whole value

oracle.ref: PR #1026 (fix); fix evidence: Review of PR #1026 (09/10/2026): the wiring test was red on any day but 08/10 because captureWishes ignored config.now; probes showed a Chinese quote refused NOT_SAID, an update with no said rewriting n1 to any text, 'Use the slogan — said: "hi" always' parsed back cut, callMayWriteSite answering false for theme.activate with dryRun, the build tool hidden on a site whose build failed, and an EmDash undo by value writing mediaView's subset. Each test here fails on the commit before its fix.
oracle.invariant: S2: every test named in run.tests reports ok, on any day (the wiring test sets the plugin's clock to 08/10/2026 and the kept note carries that date, not the real one). A Chinese or Japanese quote counts as said when it holds at least 4 of its unspaced characters and is copied from the message; one or two words are not a quote. An update or a remove whose said is missing, empty, too short, invented or taken from the old note is refused NOT_SAID and the note stays as it was; an update that quotes this message replaces the note's text and its quote. A note whose text holds ' — said: "' reads back from the file whole, with its quote unchanged. On a WordPress site whose build is running, waiting, paused or failed, a new conversation is sent tracy_site_build_wordpress from its first step; with no build on record or a build done it waits as before; the design tools and the other platform's build tool stay hidden. A tracy_site call with dryRun:true (in params or top level) is a look only for content.replace; theme.activate, extension.enable, theme.style, media.draw, db.rollback, template.siteSettings and content.update with dryRun still wait for the seal and count as changing the site. No preset of either bundle sets readMaxLineLength, readMaxBytes or readLimit on tool-fs. An EmDash content_update receipt shows a picture as its short view; a changed picture restores the live revision when there is one, otherwise the undo by value carries the whole old picture in undoData; an unchanged picture beside a short change forces no restore. Every command exits 0.
